activity_summary: You rehearsed Two Gentlemen from the door, three times, with Augustine and Nick. The third was clean. You are in tomorrow's play. You are not in this afternoon's Shrew, and Augustine told you not to come back and be useful at it. The king's leaves are not in the theatre. You did not rehearse them, and you did not open a new play.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Gave the cue, refused a fourth run, and claimed tomorrow rather than this afternoon.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Set the whistle, counted three, and told you to stay away from a play cast without you.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Missed the first by being early, and came clean on the third.

entities.name: Two Gentlemen of Verona
entities.context: Mentioned in Three times from the door

facets.activity: Rehearsed Two Gentlemen from the door three times

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Tomorrow I am in this. This afternoon I am not in the other

quotes.speaker: nick_sorrell
quotes.text: Through. Clean. I did not look at my feet;
